nounVerb.rationale_short: Heavy nominalization (74/1000) driven by the same Greek/German philosophical vocabulary as §1.4 (phantasia, phantasma, kinēsis, eidos, doxa, taking-as, making-present, articulational concretion, resonant orexis, resonant aisthēma). The be-verb rate (~1.72/sentence) is slightly below §1.4's 1.82, reflecting that §1.3 is more architectural-narrative (cases studies of thirst, deliberative flow) and thus carries more action verbs (drink, run, kneel, project, synthesize, ratify) than §1.4's definitional 'X is Y' density. Preposition rate (~3.95) is slightly below §1.4 (4.09) for the same reason. Confidence 0.74. Score 0.61 places §1.3 a hair below §1.4 on the noun-verb axis.

parataxisHypotaxis.label: hypotactic
parataxisHypotaxis.rationale_short: §1.3 is marginally MORE hypotactic than §1.4. The architectural exposition of the three orientational modes + doxa-as-orthogonal-layer requires extensive relative-clause embedding (which/that/where) to define each mode in terms of its (a) intentional direction, (b) temporal orientation, (c) phantasma-deployment, (d) relation to logos, and (e) doxastic ratifiability — and these five conditions are typically braided together within single periodic sentences (lines 5, 29, 65, 67, 114). The user's signature 'X, in which Y, where Z' three-stage construction is particularly dense in S5 (Unified Cognitive Apparatus) and S10 (Conclusion). Confidence 0.78. The +0.02 drift above the §1.4 baseline is within ALIGNED range.
parataxisHypotaxis.delta_classification: ALIGNED (within ±0.10 of §1.4 baseline 0.61); architectural density slightly increases embedding without crossing into DRIFT zone

voice.label: predominantly-active
voice.rationale_short: §1.3 retains §1.4's author-prominent active style. Aristotle observes, Aristotle insists, Heidegger reads, Papachristou insists, Frede observes — author-prominent citation is the dominant rhetorical mode. Passive constructions cluster around the philosophical-process passives ('is taken-as', 'is being-affected', 'is co-given', 'is ratified', 'is grounded in', 'is brought into actuality') where the agent is structurally irrelevant or already named in the noun phrase. The 0.21 passive ratio mirrors §1.4. Score 0.33, within 0.01 of §1.4's 0.32.

The section's transparency to itself is especially marked: 'I designate as occupying A_3', 'as I will demonstrate', 'as I have been calling orientation modes', 'the present section treats the three orientational modes in turn; the doxastic dimension will be treated last'. Explicit interpretive flagging is the dominant rhetorical mode. Confidence 0.54 (low — Tier 1 brittle on opacity). tacit_patterns.anaphora_rate: moderate-to-high. The conclusion (S10, lines 110-119) repeats 'the rational cognitive apparatus engages the phantasma along three orientational axes: the atemporal axis of intellection...; the retrospective axis of memory...; the discursive axis of deliberative phantasia...' — three-part sentence-internal anaphora. Earlier (lines 29, 31) the three modes are introduced with parallel sentence-initial 'intellection (nous), memory (mnēmē), and the discursive mode' anaphora.
tacit_patterns.antithesis_rate: very high. The section is structured around antithetical pairs: pre-propositional / propositional, taking-as / taking-as-true-or-false, voluntary phantasia / involuntary doxa, sensory phantasia / deliberative phantasia, retrospective memory / prospective deliberation, atemporal nous / temporal-orientational modes, single phantasma / synthesis of multiple phantasmata, practical / speculative, brute / rational animal, present / absent / universal, dunamis / energeia. The pre-propositional / propositional antithesis is load-bearing for the entire architecture.
tacit_patterns.isocolon_rate: high. The conclusion's three-axis enumeration uses parallel grammatical forms ('the atemporal axis of X', 'the retrospective axis of Y', 'the discursive axis of Z'). The three-thirst-cases (lines 21, 23, 25) use parallel openings and parallel closings ('You then grab the glass...'; 'Once you kneel and take a drink...'). The three-conditions-for-doxa (line 81) use isocolon: 'Belief names the assent...; Conviction names the binding force...; Discourse of reason names the medium...'.
tacit_patterns.chiasmus_rate: low-moderate. 'What phantasia discloses aspectually, doxa ratifies propositionally; what doxa ratifies, emotion mobilizes...' (line 108) is the section's clearest chiastic structure.
tacit_patterns.climax_rate: moderate-to-high. The section builds: terminological-architectural opening → three cases of thirst → orientational-mode taxonomy → unified apparatus → doxa-as-orthogonal → conclusion-as-transition-to-action. The climax sentence is the final clause of S9: 'what phantasia discloses aspectually, doxa ratifies propositionally; what doxa ratifies, emotion mobilizes into determinate conative form; what emotion mobilizes, action completes' — a four-step climactic chain.
tacit_patterns.polyptoton_rate: high. The phantasia/phantasma/phantasmata cluster is etymologically braided throughout, with deliberate variation between capacity (phantasia), activity (phantasia-as-act), product (phantasma), and plural (phantasmata). Doxa/doxazein/doxastic; nous/noein/noetic; eidos/eidetic; taking-as/take-as-true/taking-as-something-true-or-false — all are polyptotic clusters.
tacit_patterns.rationale_short: §1.3's most distinctive tacit patterns are (a) ARCHITECTURAL ANAPHORA — the three-mode triadic refrain that recurs in S5, S6, S10; (b) DOUBLE-LAYER ANTITHESIS — the pre-propositional/propositional and aspectual/propositional contrasts; and (c) CLIMACTIC TRANSITION — the four-step phantasia → doxa → emotion → action chain that bridges §1.3 to §1.4. These rhetorical patterns are MORE pronounced than in §1.4 because §1.3 is the architectural-introduction section for the M_2 → A_3 hinge that §1.4 then develops emotionally.
